history.summary: A 1,216 sqft freehold 3BR at Smailing Court (D14 Kembangan, 2002) at $1.8M / $1,480 PSF, just 340m (4 min) from Kembangan MRT. Excellent transit access and a liquid quantum/size, but no URA appreciation data and a small older development temper conviction.
history.rating_rationale: 340m to Kembangan EWL MRT is a strong, durable location anchor, and $1.8M for a 1,216 sqft freehold 3BR sits in the deep buyer-pool band. score_1000 585 and a solid 294-224-51 arena record (elo 1253) are above-average. But no URA txn/appreciation data, a 2002 build, and a modest-sized development mean appreciation is unproven — good location, ordinary investment metrics.
